requestBody.query: How to use parental controls in the Fibe TV app?

200.answer:
To use parental controls in the Fibe TV app:
1. Touch Menu to open the side navigation panel.
2. Touch Settings.
3. Touch Parental Controls.
You can set parental controls that apply to all devices or only the current one. Device-specific settings take priority.
